sections.label: The opening
sections.line: RiskMandate's partner programme: products that see agents at work gain what their logs cannot tell them.
sections.para: Gateways, identity, observability and cost tools see agents but not what each is for. A behaviour policy writes it down and turns measurements into judgements. Three ways in: integration, referral and co-sell. RiskMandate gives the mandate API, templates, co-branding and case studies; partners give evidence, unowned agents and a route to customers. Terms are proposals.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: Many products see agents; none sees what each is for; three ways to work together.
sections.para: The first case study is cost; shares and prices are proposals.

sections.label: Why a partner programme
sections.line: RiskMandate uses what the customer already has and adds the missing piece: the mandate.
sections.para: Seen already with WSO2's gateway interceptor and the cost case study; a programme makes it repeatable.

sections.label: Three ways in
sections.line: Integration partners return evidence through the mandate API; referral and co-sell partners share customers.

sections.label: What each side gives
sections.line: RiskMandate gives the API, templates, co-branding and joint case studies; partners give evidence and reach.
sections.para: Evidence turns written rows into measured ones and can be priced like insurance.

sections.label: Going to market together
sections.line: A design partner, a joint report, a published case study and a packaged offer.
sections.para: Each joint offer opens with one yes-or-no question for the customer.

sections.label: What we are looking for
